basics.name: Weijia (Charlie) Zhang
basics.label: Incoming M.S. in Computer Science @ Yale
basics.summary: Incoming Yale M.S. student in Computer Science, UIUC Computer Science and Mathematics graduate, and NLP/LLM agent researcher.

work.summary: Researching self-evolving multimodal agents for content moderation.
highlights: Designed a ReAct-based moderation agent that combines frame sampling, ASR/OCR, metadata, originality scoring, and visual detection tools into policy-grounded decisions.
Built a reflection-and-evolution loop that distills solver failures into reusable skills, improving overall F1 score by 15.5%.

work.summary: Worked on VLM/LLM agent research to improve Microsoft Excel Copilot capabilities.
highlights: Built the TextAnalysisSFT data pipeline for SFT data generation for the new TextAnalysis API in Excel Copilot.
Mined 2000+ real Kaggle samples, filtered heavy-text sheets, generated queries and Office.js code, and validated outputs with SheetEngine.
Delivered a dataset that improved Office Script code-generation accuracy by 75%.

work.summary: Built real-time role-playing agent systems in Unity VR.
highlights: Developed a role-playing agent Unity VR game enabling agents to interact through text, voice, and VR actions in real time with under 1s latency.
Introduced RAG and vector databases to strengthen long-term agent memory, improving dialogue coherence score from 2/5 to 4/5.
Designed a reusable character-card framework, enabling a UGC ecosystem and reducing character persona configuration time by 300%.

work.summary: Built performance analysis tooling for WeChat Mini Programs and Unity memory profiling.
highlights: Developed a cross-platform Android and iOS hardware performance analysis tool for WeChat Mini Programs, supporting 200+ partner teams in identifying performance bottlenecks.
Built a Unity Mono Memory Profiler that discovered 40+ hidden memory allocation points, reducing memory-leak-related crash rate by 120%.
